hero.subtitle: I'm **Santiago Romero**. I design and build web and mobile applications, APIs and business process automation, from problem analysis to deployment. I currently develop the automation solutions at **Cajasan**.

about.label: ABOUT ME
about.p1: I'm a full stack software developer based in Bucaramanga, Colombia. My work spans two fronts: building web and mobile applications, and automating business processes.
about.p2: I take every project end to end: I understand the process, design the architecture, build the frontend, backend and database, and ship it to production. I care that software doesn't just work, but is maintainable and its impact can be measured.
about.p3: I trained as a Full Stack Software Development Technician at Campuslands and I'm pursuing a Software Engineering degree at Universidad de Santander, complementing hands-on experience with solid engineering fundamentals.

distrib-app.title: DistribApp — Management for a distributor
distrib-app.description: Mobile application that digitized a panela distributor's operation: sales, inventory, clients and accounting in real time.
distrib-app.problem: A panela distributor in Colombia managed all their sales and inventory in paper notebooks, causing information loss, difficulty calculating profits and a lack of control over the business.

misfinanzas.title: MisFinanzas — Personal finance
misfinanzas.description: Installable PWA to manage expenses, spending limits and savings goals, with per-user data in the cloud.
misfinanzas.problem: Keeping personal finances in notes or spreadsheets makes it hard to know where the money goes each month and to reach savings goals.
solution: Sign-up and login with Supabase Auth
Dashboard with balance and monthly income vs. expenses
Installable as an app on iPhone and Android

dataflix.title: DataFlix — Learn databases
dataflix.description: Web platform to learn databases from scratch, with courses, assessments and progress tracking.
dataflix.problem: There was no free, visual and accessible platform to learn databases practically and autonomously in Spanish.

foodstars.title: FoodStars — Restaurant ranking
foodstars.description: Platform to discover, rate and rank restaurants: a REST API with Node.js and Express, and a frontend with search and an admin dashboard.
foodstars.problem: Review platforms usually sort only by average stars, ignoring community interaction and how recent the reviews are.
solution: JWT authentication with user and admin roles
Weighted ranking by rating, likes and recency
Transactions and Aggregation Framework in MongoDB
Frontend with search, filters and admin dashboard

gym.title: GymMaster CLI
gym.description: Command-line gym management system with MongoDB, atomic transactions and reports.
gym.problem: A gym needed to manage clients, plans, payments and progress from a single robust tool without an expensive graphical interface.
solution: Complete CRUD for clients and plans

pizza.title: Pizza y Punto
pizza.description: Pizzeria system with orders, inventory, delivery drivers and sales analysis.
pizza.problem: A pizzeria needed to centralize orders, inventory, drivers and billing in a single efficient and reliable system.
